SELECT

    env_metrics->'tracking'->>'stop_duration_min' as stop_dur,

FROM shipments s

LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
    s.reckey,
    s.shiptok,
    em.env_metrics->'temperature'->>'excursion_count' as temp_excursion_count,
    em.env_metrics->'temperature'->>'excursion_duration_min' as ted_minutes,
    em.env_metrics->'temperature'->>'alarm_count' as alarm_count,
    sp.actual_duration_hrs::int * 60 as total_transit_min,
    ROUND(CAST((sp.actual_duration_hrs::int * 60 - COALESCE(em.env_metrics->'temperature'->>'excursion_duration_min', '0')::numeric) / NULLIF(sp.actual_duration_hrs::int * 60, 0) * 100 AS numeric), 2) as tirp_pct,
    ir.risk_level,
    ic.claimstat,
    ic.claimusd,
    qc.qc_checklist->'release'->>'product_release_status' as release_status
FROM shipments s
JOIN environmentalmonitoring em ON s.reckey = em.reckeylink
JOIN shipsensorlink ssl ON s.reckey = ssl.shpnode
LEFT JOIN incidentandriskmanagement ir ON s.reckey = ir.reckeyrisk
LEFT JOIN insuranceclaims ic ON s.reckey = ic.reckeyclaim
LEFT JOIN qualitycompliance qc ON s.reckey = qc.reckeyqc
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT s.shipment_overview->'timing_performance'->>'actual_duration_hrs' as actual_duration_hrs
) sp
WHERE COALESCE(em.env_metrics->'temperature'->>'excursion_count', '0')::int > 0
   OR ir.risk_level IN ('High', 'Medium')
   OR ic.claimstat IS NOT NULL
   OR qc.qc_checklist->'release'->>'product_release_status' != 'Released'
ORDER BY ted_minutes DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 20;
